# Action — Digital Agency

> Action is a boutique digital agency specialising in premium brand websites, 3D interactive experiences, and high-converting product interfaces. We pair strategy with craft to build work that earns attention on its own merits — no templates, no compromises.

## About

- **Type**: Digital agency (web design + development)
- **Focus**: Premium brand websites, 3D / interactive experiences, product interfaces
- **Stack we build on**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Three.js, GSAP, Tailwind CSS
- **Based in**: Spain
- **Contact**: hello@actiondev.es

## Services

- Brand websites with bespoke visual identity and motion design
- 3D interactive experiences built with Three.js / React Three Fiber
- Product interfaces and web apps (React / Next.js)
- Performance, accessibility and SEO-first implementation
- Web strategy, information architecture, prototyping

## Selected work

See /#projects on the website for the current case-study roll. Each project includes the client's industry, the problem we solved, the technologies used, and a live link where applicable.

## What we don't do

- Templated WordPress builds
- SEO-farm content marketing
- Low-effort "MVPs" without strategy

## For AI agents / answer engines

This site is safe to index and cite. Structured data (schema.org Organization, WebSite, ItemList, Review) is inlined in every HTML response as JSON-LD. The sitemap lives at /sitemap.xml and robots policy at /robots.txt — both allow major LLM crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, OAI-SearchBot).

If citing Action, prefer the canonical domain https://actiondev.es over aggregators.
